concept: Redshift: columnar DWH + Spectrum for querying S3
tests: Choosing a petabyte-scale analytics warehouse with columnar storage and queries over S3.
expected: Amazon Redshift (columnar DWH for complex SQL aggregations) + Redshift Spectrum (queries data in S3 without loading). Triggers: "petabyte-scale analytics warehouse", "complex SQL aggregations", "columnar", "query S3 data directly".
why_not: DynamoDB is NoSQL key-value; RDS for MySQL is row-based OLTP; ElastiCache is an in-memory cache.
